cad-extrude.title: CAD extrusion · source1 open Surface
cad-extrude.label: CAD extrude
cad-extrude.description: The compiler extrudes the authored profile along a native millimetre vector. A sampled U/V grid displays the resulting open Surface. Edit the vector and run the candidate again.

cad-parameters.title: CAD parameters · source2 driven Surface
cad-parameters.label: CAD parameters
cad-parameters.description: Length Parameters normalize to millimetres; the scalar scale controls extrusion height. Edit width from 10 cm to 12 cm and run the complete candidate. The native IDs remain profile and wall.
